positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Algorithms · Java · Software Development · COBOL · z/OS · Modernization · Job Control Language (JCL)

positions.title: Resident Advisor
positions.description: Worked as a Resident Advisor in Newman Hall, helping students transition into living on campus, planning and leading hall events, and handling roommate conflicts and conduct violations. I acted as a resource for students who needed help with anything from finding the library to navigating anxiety.

positions.title: Floor Assembler
positions.description: Assembled parts and crates as a part of a team in the warehouse. The position was heavily reliant on teamwork to meet weekly quotas for our area.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Worked with the IT department on websites for company-managed organizations, including web design through WordPress and HTML, as well as answering support tickets.

positions.title: Ride Operator
positions.description: Operated the ride board for The Berserker and checked restraints/ensured rider safety.
